topic: Write a Book Review of Tuesdays with Morrie(写一篇《相约星期二》读后感/书评)
title_en: A Book That Changed the Way I Live
genre: 书评 / 读后感(introduce the book + share one life lesson + recommend it)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修四 Unit 2 写作:为《相约星期二》写一篇约100词的书评/读后感,要求自然运用被动语态。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李华,学校英语社团征集“一本改变了我的书”的短文。请用英语写一篇约100词的书评,内容包括:① 简要介绍《相约星期二》(作者/人物/它讲什么);② 谈一条你从中学到的人生道理;③ 把它推荐给同学。注意:恰当使用被动语态(如 The book was written by…/We are reminded that…),语言准确连贯。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your school English club is collecting short pieces titled 'A Book That Changed Me'. Write a book review (about 100 words) of Tuesdays with Morrie, including: 1) a brief introduction to the book (author, people, what it is about); 2) one life lesson you have learned from it; 3) a recommendation to your classmates. Use the passive voice naturally where appropriate.
points: 简介这本书(written by Mitch Albom / it is about…)
你学到的一条道理(I was reminded that… / We should…)
推荐给同学(It should be read by everyone who…)
恰当、自然地使用被动语态,行文连贯
model_essay: Tuesdays with Morrie was written by Mitch Albom, a busy journalist who was reunited with his old professor, Morrie. When it was discovered that Morrie was being weakened by a severe illness, Mitch began visiting him every Tuesday, and their talks were turned into this gentle book. I was deeply moved by one lesson: how we live should be chosen by ourselves, not decided by society. After reading it, I was reminded to value my family and to keep in touch with old friends. This book is filled with hope, and I believe it should be read by every young person at least once.
model_translation: 《相约星期二》由忙碌的记者米奇·阿尔博姆所写,他与老教授莫里重聚。当人们得知莫里正被一场重病拖垮时,米奇开始每周二去探望他,他们的谈话被写成了这本温柔的书。有一条道理深深打动了我:怎样生活应由自己选择,而不是由社会决定。读完后,我被提醒要珍惜家人、与老友保持联系。这本书满含希望,我相信每个年轻人都至少该读它一遍。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:介绍书 / 一条人生道理 / 推荐同学
围绕一本书展开、句句相关、衔接自然、代词指代清楚
被动语态等句型准确多样、词汇得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 介绍 Tuesdays with Morrie was written by Mitch Albom…
讲述 their talks were turned into this book
道理 I was reminded that… / how we live should be chosen by ourselves
推荐 It should be read by every young person at least once.
key_expressions: Tuesdays with Morrie was written by Mitch Albom.
Morrie was being weakened by a severe illness.
I was reminded to value my family and keep in touch with old friends.
It should be read by every young person at least once.

high_sentences: Tuesdays with Morrie was written by Mitch Albom, who was reunited with his old professor.
When it was discovered that Morrie was being weakened by a severe illness, Mitch began visiting him.
How we live should be chosen by ourselves, not decided by society.
This book is filled with hope, and it should be read by everyone at least once.

error_pairs.wrong: The book was wrote by Mitch Albom.
error_pairs.correct: The book was written by Mitch Albom.
error_pairs.note: 被动语态用过去分词 written,不是过去式 wrote。

error_pairs.wrong: Morrie was weakened by a illness now.
error_pairs.correct: Morrie is being weakened by an illness now.
error_pairs.note: now 表示此刻正在进行 → 现在进行被动 is being done。

error_pairs.wrong: This book should read by everyone.
error_pairs.correct: This book should be read by everyone.
error_pairs.note: 情态动词后的被动是 should be done,不能漏掉 be。

paragraph_template:
【《相约星期二》书评结构】
第1-2句 介绍:… was written by … / it is about …
第3-4句 道理:I was reminded that … / how we live should be chosen by ourselves
第5句 推荐:It should be read by every young person at least once.
